name: Admin Panel Unsaved Changes Guard
description: The shared unsaved-changes guard as rolled out across the panel's full-page editors (blog, portfolio, linktrees, hour-packages, diagnostics/create, accounting/settings, emails), using /panel/emails as the representative case because its state lives in loose refs rather than a form object. Editing a default raises a warning naming the field (data-testid emails-defaults-unsaved-notice), and leaving the page opens the three-way dialog whose primary exit saves and only then navigates. Pins the boundary that matters for tabbed pages: switching tabs is a same-route router.replace({ query }), which must NOT trip the leave guard — otherwise every tabbed panel page would block on a modal as soon as its form had anything pending — and must not discard what is pending either.
